app.name: Roundtable
language.label: Interface language
meetings.title: Meetings
sidebar.rules: One public speaker at a time · Up to 10 rounds · You decide
welcome.eyebrow: Bring different judgments to the same table
welcome.title: One question. Several perspectives.
welcome.body: Let real agents investigate, respond, and verify. Keep the evidence and dissent, then make your decision.
composer.label: Add a message or decision criteria
composer.placeholder: For example: verify this assumption before comparing options.
composer.normal: Your message will join the shared record.
composer.running: Published after the current turn for later participants to read.
composer.independent: Additions are published after the reports, keeping this investigation’s inputs consistent.
evidence.title: Claims and evidence
evidence.note: A citation does not mean a claim is verified. Checks retain their author and method.
evidence.select: Select a claim to inspect its evidence, method, and limits.
evidence.noLimits: No limits supplied by the author; verification remains pending.
new.title: New roundtable
new.topic: What would you like to discuss?
new.placeholder: Describe the question, background, and your decision criteria.
new.modeNote: Submit independently, then publish together and compare. Investigation counts as round 1.
new.note: Up to 10 rounds, with early summary available. Uses your existing CLI accounts and their quota.
participants.title: Participants
provider.agy: Model identity and shared MCP unverified
provider.noIndependent: Independent investigation unavailable on this Mac
meeting.incomplete: Partial material: some participants have no complete report
reports.wait: Reports are published together when ready. Peer conclusions stay private until then.
decision.pending: After the discussion, a draft will collect recommendations, pros, cons, and dissent.
decision.working: Preparing a draft from the public record.
decision.author: Final summary prepared by Leader {author} · You decide
decision.failed: Summary failed · Original statements retained below
decision.empty: Not listed in the draft; does not imply unanimous confirmation.
decision.userPlaceholder: Record your choice, reasons, or questions for further investigation.
shared.title: Shared capabilities
shared.body: Maintain one configuration. Codex and Claude receive adapted settings; independent investigation uses only isolated built-in meeting tools.
shared.libraryNote: Public records, research, and claim checks. Each call accesses only its authorized view.
shared.externalNote: Changes apply to new meetings. Use envRefs for credentials and allowedTools for explicit tools. External shared memory is disabled during independent investigation; AGY shared MCP remains unverified.
error.auth: Missing local session authorization. Open through the desktop app or the service launch URL.
error.selectParticipants: Choose at least two available participants.
restart.title: Restart investigation
restart.note: Old reports are retained. Every participant receives the same revised question.
export.title: Export meeting
history.recoveredWithoutArtifacts: This legacy meeting was recovered from the running app. Public statements, claims, draft, and call statuses are preserved; original call files were lost during an alpha bundle rebuild and have not been recovered.
provider.agyIndependent: Independent report available · Shared tools are not scoped yet
organizer.label: Organizer · coordination
organizer.roles: Organizer coordinates only. Participants investigate and discuss; the selected Leader prepares the final summary.
organizer.login: Complete cursor-agent login, then return to this window
organizer.suggestSummary: Organizer suggests summarizing. Participants and the round limit still determine completion.
status.authenticated: CLI login confirmed · Model calls unverified
followup.note: Ask one participant at a time. Automatic selection uses the public record; answers preserve the original summary and round count.
followup.label: Your follow-up question
followup.manual: Selected by you · Organizer routing skipped
composer.question: Continue asking questions
composer.continue: Ask in this conversation. The selected participant answers without overwriting the original summary.
summary.outdated: New questions or answers are not yet included. Regenerate the summary when you finish asking.
